extracted.name: Pineapple Sticky Ribs
extracted.description: Finger-licking, tender pork ribs are baked in a sticky, savory-sweet mixture of pineapple tidbits, apricot jam, and soy sauce for a crowd-pleasing meal.
ingredient_lines: 3 pounds pork back ribs, separated and fat trimmed
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Arrange ribs in a single layer in a roasting pan.
Stir pineapple, jam, soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl. Pour evenly over ribs.

Bake in the preheated oven, basting every 15 minutes, until ribs are glazed and pull away easily from bone, about 1 1/2 hours. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of meat should read 145 degrees F (63 degrees C).
